name: Quick-Step
verdict: Quick-Step is an Unilin flooring brand; Unilin is part of the US-listed Mohawk Industries Inc.
note: Unilin flooring brand. Mohawk Industries is widely held; its 5%+ holders are documented in the mohawk-industries-shareholders claim (2026 proxy): Lorberbaum family 16.5%, BlackRock 9.9%, Dimensional 5.1%, no state or state fund. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. NewsChannel 9 (WTVC, 2018-03-20, https://newschannel9.com/news/local/mohawk-worker-killed-in-accident-at-murray-county-plant-tuesday) reports two worker deaths at Mohawk's Chatsworth, Georgia plant within six months: Vickie Dyer, killed 1 September 2017, for which OSHA fined Mohawk almost $13,000, and Roy Glenn Bass, killed 20 March 2018 (OSHA notified; outcome not opened). Whether a paid OSHA penalty for a fatal industrial accident is a regulator finding of deaths or injuries under METHOD (which would set Concern) is a maintainer's decision.
